Name: (CP)(FS) Churpy's Vivid Hairstyles - Flower Garden Set
Author: Churpix
Description:
Hello! I am happy to share my first mod. I wanted to create a hair mod that didn't feel out of place in Stardew Valley stylistically but also have a lot of flexibility to create vivid and natural colours.

All 20 hairstyles have 4 tint variants for a total of 96 hairstyles. Un-tinted versions are also included! These hairstyles occupy slots 75 - 174 in the character creation menu.

══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══
[b]Warm Tones[/b]
Rose
Lemon

[b]Cool Tones[/b]
Lavender
Mint
══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══

When you colour pick your hairstyle in-game, the colour will be affected by the base hairstyle tint. 

UN-TINTED VERSION NOW AVAILABLE. Adjusted to make more natural white hair colours possible!


══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══
[b]IMPORTANT[/b]
All hairstyles included in this set are made for Peach Body chubby ver. found [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]here[/url]. I cannot guarantee that this mod will look good and may have visual issues with other body types including vanilla.

I can create a new version if there are any issues. I have not heavily play tested these hairstyles yet. This is my very first mod so there may be mistakes. Thank you!

This mod creates 96 new hairstyle slots in the character creation menu. It does not overwrite any vanilla hairstyles. Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113270318]halpyy[/url] as I referenced your mod's code and file structure for Content Patcher to create mine!

Also a special thanks to [url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09]Kkunma[/url]﻿ on Naver who created some of the hairstyles I referenced to make this mod. The styles I referenced aren't exactly 1 for 1 but the general shapes and themes are the same for some styles. Thank you for inspiring me!

══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══
[b]USAGE AND PERMISSIONS[/b]
To further clarify my usage of [url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09]Kkunma[/url]'s work within this mod:

As per [url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09]Kkunma[/url]﻿'s content use policy, secondary processing (editing) and redistribution are permitted.[url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09] Kkunma[/url]﻿ also states that credit should be given in good faith, but is not a requirement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iHSk3QU.png[/img]
[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122051154/https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09/222147242931]Archived Webpage[/url]

Hairstyles 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 14, 15, and 16 are derivative versions of[url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09] Kkunma[/url]'s original hairstyles, completely reshaded and re-pixeled in my own style. Some have their basic shapes modified to varying degrees, some are heavily modified, and some are nearly identical to the original in shape. Beyond my re-pixeling and modifications, all credit for these hairstyles belongs to[url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09] Kkunma[/url] and [url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09]Kkunma[/url] alone.

Hairstyles 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, and 20 are pixeled from scratch. Any similarities to [url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09]Kkunma[/url]'s work in these hairstyles is inspired as I attempted to make everything stylistically cohesive. 

I have not used or referenced the work of any mod creators other than those mentioned above.

[b]Please contact me directly if you have any concerns over my usage of other mod author's work. I take permissions very seriously and hope that in good faith I can ensure that all contributors to this mod are consenting and properly credited.
[/b]
